## 5. Complete Technical Stack Breakdown

### Frontend Technologies
- **Next.js (App Router / Pages)**: Server Components, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), Route Handlers, SEO Optimization.
- **React 18 / 19**: Component lifecycle, custom hooks, context state management, memoization, Framer Motion.
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3.
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, Vanilla CSS, CSS Grid, Flexbox, Glassmorphism, Dark Mode architecture.

### Backend & API Technologies
- **Node.js**: Asynchronous event-driven server runtime.
- **Express.js**: RESTful endpoint architecture, middleware composition, request sanitization, error handlers.
- **Authentication & Security**: JWT (JSON Web Tokens), CORS policy configuration, environment security.

### Mobile Technologies
- **Flutter**: Single codebase cross-platform compilation for Android and iOS.
- **Dart**: Strong typing, asynchronous programming (Futures, Streams), reactive UI state.

### Databases & Cloud Storage
- **MongoDB**: Document-based schema modeling with Mongoose, aggregation pipelines, indexing.
- **MySQL**: Relational schema design, normalization, foreign keys, SQL optimization.
- **Firebase / Firestore**: Real-time database, authentication, and static asset storage.

### Tooling, Deployment & DevOps
- **Version Control**: Git, GitHub, pull request reviews, feature-branch workflows.
- **Hosting & CI/CD**: Vercel, GitHub Pages, Firebase Hosting.
- **Development Tools**: Visual Studio Code, Postman API Client, Chrome DevTools, npm/yarn.
